server: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again.
unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
notFound: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
conflict: That conflicts with the current state. Please refresh and try again.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
validation: Please check the information you entered and try again.
timeout: The request timed out. Please try again.
offline: You're offline. Please check your connection.
alreadyMember: You're already part of that household.
alreadyClockedIn: You're already clocked in on another shift. Clock out of it first.
cancelViaDelete: Cancel time off by using the delete option instead.
entryNotEditable: This entry can't be changed any more — the week has already been approved. Ask your household to query it.
entryVoided: This entry was voided and no longer counts toward your hours.
invalidClockTimes: Those times don't work. The finish must be after the start, and can't be in the future.
clockSpanTooLong: One shift can't run longer than 16 hours. Check the finish time — a finish earlier in the day than the start is read as the next day.
clockOutChangesWeek: The finish has to be in the same week as the start. Add this as two entries, one for each week.
timeEntryOverlaps: That finish overlaps another entry on {{day}} ({{range}}). You're still on the clock — open Hours, shorten that entry, then clock out again.
timeEntryOverlapsRunning: That clashes with a shift you're still clocked into on {{day}}. Clock out of that one first, then add these hours.
memberHasRunningEntry: This person is clocked in on a shift. Ask them to clock out first, then try removing them again.
